segments.narration: A city bigger than London stood in Illinois. Around ten fifty AD, on the Mississippi floodplain, and its name is Cahokia.
At its height it held tens of thousands of people, more than London had at the same moment.
Monks Mound is the centre of it. Thirty metres high, and its base covers more ground than the Great Pyramid.
They built a circle of red cedar posts to track the sun, and moved an estimated fifty million cubic feet of earth in baskets.
By fourteen hundred it was empty. Deforestation, flooding and shifting climate are the leading explanations, and no single one closes the case.
